pr_title: LE Audio: Rename MICS to MICP and use role names
pr_body:
This PR basically renames the entire Microphone Input Control Profile (MICP) implementation. 

The server side is renamed to MICP Microphone Device (bt_micp_mic_dev), and the client side is renamed to MICP Microphone Controller (bt_micp_mic_ctlr). This generally add renamings such as mics->micp and then adding the role name, as well as renaming the public header and Kconfigs from MICS to MICP. 

This PR also removes the bt_micp_aics API, as the AICS instance pointer can be used directly with the AICS API instead with the same functionality, which cleans up the implementation significantly. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/45558

Comment for reviewers:
You can review however you like, but for your sake I would focus on the `micp.h` public header file, as well as the `Kconfig.micp` file, as everything else has just been simple renames based on the changes in those files (except for the removed `bt_mics_aics` functions).
pr_comments: @asbjornsabo from the Naming Conventions RFC I think it was also suggested that "verb-noun" was recommended (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/30892/files#r552095727), so I wonder if we should also change the API from e.g. `bt_micp_mic_dev_mute_get` to `bt_micp_mic_dev_get_mute` as part of these PRs as well?

> @asbjornsabo from the Naming Conventions RFC I think it was also suggested that "verb-noun" was recommended (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/30892/files#r552095727), so I wonder if we should also change the API from e.g. `bt_micp_mic_dev_mute_get` to `bt_micp_mic_dev_get_mute` as part of these PRs as well?

Was there ever a clear conclusion to that?  At least the PR was not merged.
I can live with either, but suggest that we either wait with this change or (preferably) get some confirmation from the API group on what they prefer before doing the change.
(That change can be a separate commit, IMO.)

review_comments:
Thoughts on naming:
"micp" is for the profile (as agreed).
"mic_dev" is for the role ("Microphone Device").
The combination gives us the "_micp_mic_" - do we need that?  Could/should this be shortened to e.g. "micp_dev"?
Or could/should we concatenate the words of the role name, to emphasize that this is one thing: "micdev"?
I guess we would need to look at more advanced specs to see the consequences.  For e.g. BAP, we want to keep the "unicast" and "broadcast" parts of the role names, as having only the last parts ("source", "client") would be confusing.

My default is to keep naming as is here.

> My default is to keep naming as is here.

Same

IMO `micp_dev` and `micp_ctlr` is "as bad" as just using `bap_source` and `bap_client` (especially the former, since "device" is very generic).
